p.title: Pages release verification failed code deploys on stale data, and the watchdog read an in-flight deploy as untrusted
p.symptom: 13 of 14 red Deploy GitHub Pages runs (11/01-11/03) had deployed successfully and then failed 'Verify released Pages' on pages-data-freshness/pages-telegram-freshness or pages-news-feeds-alive. Each failed run then failed the watchdog's pages-deployment-run-provenance (22 red watchdog runs, conclusion=failure), and 22 more watchdog runs went red on the same check with status=in_progress while the deploy run was still verifying.
p.root_cause: ci-external-pipeline-check.mjs --mode release judged data-plane freshness as an error, so a stalled producer failed every source release; the watchdog already owns that verdict. Separately, deployment.json goes live when the deploy step ends, minutes before its run completes, and isTrustedDeploymentRun allowed in_progress only for the release's own run.
p.fix: In release mode the data, screener and Telegram freshness checks and the news-feed check are warnings (the watchdog keeps them as errors). In watchdog mode the Pages provenance run may be in_progress; repository, branch, name, event and exact SHA checks are unchanged, and a run that then fails verification is still caught as completed=failure.
p.violated_rule: v59.48 ownership split: each plane is judged once, by the workflow that owns it
p.prevention: {R}: the release verdict covers what the release changed (exact SHA, identity, config, Workers); data age is judged only by the watchdog.
p.verification: Watchdog artifacts 10/28-11/04 (163 red runs) reclassified: 22 provenance[in_progress] and 22 provenance[completed-fail] whose Pages run failed only on data freshness/news feeds.

r.title: Data age is the watchdog's verdict, not a release's
r.rule: ci-external-pipeline-check.mjs --mode release reports pages data/screener/Telegram freshness and pages-news-feeds-alive as warnings; --mode watchdog keeps them as errors and accepts an in-progress Deploy GitHub Pages run as provenance when its identity and SHA match.

qa.text: v59.70: a code release whose attested data is old deploys green with a freshness warning; the watchdog stays red for the data age

changelog: **One verdict per plane (v59.70, {P}/{R}):** a stalled producer no longer fails code deploys (13 of 14 red Pages runs), and the watchdog no longer goes red while a deploy is still verifying itself (22 runs).
note: Actions reliability: release verify judges the release; watchdog judges data age
